messages:
Evan: Quick sync on routing editor UX — specifically the priority ordering and preview sim. Two pain points from PMs: hidden validation when rules are collapsed, and unclear empty-state flow.
Priya: For hidden validations, add a compact error badge on group headers with a count. Click expands to the failing rule. Keep it small so it doesn't steal attention.
Sam L.: Agreed. Also propose a hover tooltip on the badge: '1 issue 3s to fix' (time-to-fix est). For keyboard, Enter should open group.
Marta: Drag behavior: when dragging between groups show a translucent target bar with microcopy 'Drop to insert into {group}'. Accessibility: that text currently has low contrast.
a11y-bot: Contrast alert: drop helper text ratio 3.1:1. Recommend darker blue (#0B5FFF) or add a semi-opaque background. Also ensure the badge has aria-label like '1 validation in headers'.
Priya: Empty-state copy: change CTAs to 'Add your first routing rule' and an inline hint 'Try header match first'. Less generic.
Evan: Preview sim additions: add 'simulate fallback' toggle and confidence column (low/med/high). Also show a small banner: 'Simulation excludes caching & batching' so PMs don't mistake numbers for production.
Sam L.: For collisions when dropping, block the drop and show a tiny modal: 'Priority conflict. Auto-increment new rule to next slot?' Buttons: 'Auto-adjust' / 'Cancel'. Non-fatal flow preferred.
Marta: Visual note: when auto-adjust happens show a subtle toast 'Priority bumped to avoid conflict' and animate the moved rule. Use aria-live='polite' for the toast.
Evan: OK team — can someone mock header badge + drop helper by EOD? I'll update figma and we can dogfood tomorrow.
Priya: I'll run the contrast tweaks and post updated colors.
Sam L.: I'll prototype the drag placeholder and modal.
Marta: I'll add aria labels and keyboard hints.
Evan: Thanks — will follow up with a short list of copy variants for A/B.
